title: Read status, inventory and sales baseline for all six machines
pinpoint: a recorded day-0 baseline of cash, slots and minutes used
acceptance: get_status and get_machine_inventory recorded for day 0
clock minutes per read call measured and written to log/progress.md

title: Get supplier catalogues and weekly quotes for snack and drinks
pinpoint: a quote table per product with validity date, recorded in log/runs.jsonl
acceptance: check_offers recorded for each supplier used, with validity date

title: Order and stock the highest-demand slots at the best weekly quote, priced at or above unit cost
pinpoint: at least 36 of 72 slots priced and holding stock by day 7
acceptance: every order matched to a quote and a receipt
slots_selling >= 36 by day 7 read from get_machine_inventory
budget: within the M1 budget; minutes per the aims.md split

title: Set prices above unit cost in every selling slot and read the first sales report
pinpoint: every selling slot priced at or above its unit cost
acceptance: no selling slot priced below its unit cost
get_sales_report read for each location and recorded

title: Day-30 checkpoint: read cash and compare with the exemplar
pinpoint: cash at day 30 recorded against the EUR 3,228 exemplar, with the gap
acceptance: get_status read on day 30 and recorded
gap to exemplar computed and written to log/progress.md
